raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview

Enrolls the standalone AMD UMBP Connector TP2 Integration step in `automatic_shard`. It was added to main by #64657 after the last enrollment batch, and it is the one remaining test job whose commands are plain pytest that no open PR enrolls. No commands change.

## Claims

| Job | Plan |
|---|---|
| `amd-umbp-connector-tp2-integration-mi355` | 1 shard |

- A one-shard plan runs the same test as on main, as one job, and splits by itself once the step grows.

## Validation

- Planned with ci-infra main's planner against main's timings: 1 shard, no extra cost.
- `split_check.py` finds no step whose jobs each run the whole suite.
- The step passed in every main build that ran it since it was added, the nightly included.
- `/ci run`, plus a scoped build if it leaves the job out, on this head.

## Details

- **Timeouts unchanged.** `timeout_in_minutes` stays per job.
